rows.note: This is the all-purpose result construction for making a photo, image, or other thing indistinct.

example.english: I used my phone to blur the photo.
example.traditional: 我用手機整到張相片模糊晒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 sau2 gei1 zing2 dou3 zoeng1 soeng2 pin3 mou4 wu4 saai3

rows.note: Use this when something gradually becomes indistinct rather than being made blurry by someone.

example.english: As it got dark, the distant mountains started to blur.
example.traditional: 天一黑，遠處啲山變到模糊晒喇。
example.jyutping: tin1 jat1 hak1 jyun5 cyu3 di1 saan1 bin3 dou3 mou4 wu4 saai3 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when writing, ink, or a surface is smeared or smudged by rubbing or handling.

example.english: I accidentally caused the writing on the receipt to blur by rubbing it.
example.traditional: 我唔小心將張收據上面啲字抹花咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 zoeng1 zoeng1 sau1 geoi3 soeng6 min6 di1 zi6 mut3 faa1 zo2

rows.traditional: 搞到 A 睇嘢矇晒
rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A tai2 je5 mung4 saai3
rows.note: Use this when glare or another cause makes someone's vision blurry or dim.

example.english: Those headlights made everything in front of me blur.
example.traditional: 對車頭燈搞到我睇嘢矇晒。
example.jyutping: deoi3 ce1 tau4 dang1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 tai2 je5 mung4 saai3
